technology_name: FABRICATION OF IN-SITU MICROALGAL SHEET FOR CARBON DIOXIDE SEQUESTRATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Industrial carbon capture setups demand enormous chemical scrubbers, expensive high-volume bioreactors, and are difficult to deploy flexibly in urban spaces.
description: An in-situ biological microalgal sheet formulation synthesized by embedding live microalgal cultures inside a matrix of sodium alginate, polyethylene glycol (PEG), and hydroxypropyl cellulose (HPC) to boost sheet elasticity and lifecycle duration.
applications: Industrial carbon capture walls, urban green architecture panels, indoor office air filtration units, and commercial greenhouse gas balancing accessories.
